description: Hardening slice from the steps1-4 review (section 6): (F1) enforce lecturer->subject scope on questionService AND rubricService; (F2) add requireAuth to the three unauthenticated legacy mounts /topics, /evaluations, /api/lecturer; (F3) hard-fail a missing JWT_SECRET in production while keeping the dev/mock/test fallback. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but ordered first because it establishes the subject-scope threading and auth-guard patterns the exam-session domain mirrors. Grounded in: app.js (TokenService fallback ~line 99, the three legacy mounts), questionService.js (no scope today), rubricService.js (no scope today), materialService._assertSubjectInScope pattern, subjectRepository.listSubjectIdsForLecturer, middleware/auth.js requireAuth.
steps: F3: Create d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step5-exams\backend\src\auth\resolveJwtSecret.js exporting resolveJwtSecret(runtimeEnv): when runtimeEnv.awsMockMode===false AND (!runtimeEnv.jwtSecret || runtimeEnv.jwtSecret.trim()===''), throw an Error (code 'JWT_SECRET_REQUIRED') to fail startup; otherwise return runtimeEnv.jwtSecret || 'aives-dev-insecure-secret'. In backend/src/app.js replace the inline `secret: runtimeEnv.jwtSecret || 'aives-dev-insecure-secret'` in the TokenService wiring with resolveJwtSecret(runtimeEnv).

F3 test: add d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step5-exams\backend\test\jwtSecretGuardService.test.js (node:test) asserting: {awsMockMode:true, jwtSecret:''} returns the fallback; {awsMockMode:false, jwtSecret:''} throws with code JWT_SECRET_REQUIRED; {awsMockMode:false, jwtSecret:'real'} returns 'real'.

F2: In backend/src/app.js change the three legacy mounts to insert the auth guard: `app.use('/topics', authMiddleware.requireAuth, createTopicRouter(topicController))`, same for '/evaluations' (createEvaluationRouter) and '/api/lecturer' (createLecturerDataRouter). Do NOT delete the routers/controllers; /api/lecturer still backs EvaluationReview until Step 8.

F1 questionService: inject subjectRepository into QuestionService (wire in app.js where it is already constructed). Add private _assertSubjectInScope(user, subjectId) mirroring materialService (ADMIN bypass; LECTURER must be in subjectRepository.listSubjectIdsForLecturer(user.id); else throw 403 FORBIDDEN) and _subjectIdForTopic(topicId) via topicRepository.getById(topicId).subject_id. Thread an acting `user` arg into listQuestions, getQuestionById, createQuestion, updateQuestion, approve, reject, archive, approveBatch. Reads filter/allow only in-scope subjects; writes 403 when out of scope. Rows/topics with null subject_id skip the check (lenient fallback like _assertRubricInSubject). Update backend/src/controllers/questionController.js to pass req.user into each service call. Preserve existing behavior when user is undefined and subject_id is null so current tests keep passing.

F1 rubricService: inject subjectRepository into RubricService (wire in app.js). Add _assertSubjectInScope(user, subjectId) using the rubric row's subject_id (ADMIN bypass; null subject_id skips). Guard updateRubric, cloneRubric, deleteRubric (403 out of scope) and scope-filter listRubrics / guard getRubricById. Thread req.user from backend/src/controllers/rubricController.js into each call.

F1 tests: add in-scope allow + out-of-scope 403 + ADMIN bypass for a read and a write on BOTH services. Extend backend/test/questionService.test.js and backend/test/rubricService.test.js, or add backend/test/questionScopeService.test.js and backend/test/rubricScopeService.test.js (must end in Service.test.js). Use injected fake subjectRepository (listSubjectIdsForLecturer returns [inScopeId]).

F2 test coverage: add an offline-safe assertion (node:test + supertest against createApp with no auth cookie, or in the FEAT-002 e2e suite) that GET /topics, /evaluations, /api/lecturer/sessions now return 401.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && npm test` passes including new jwtSecretGuardService test and the F1 scope tests; the existing 163 unit tests still pass.
resolveJwtSecret throws for awsMockMode:false + empty secret and returns the fallback only in mock/dev/test.
questionService and rubricService deny out-of-scope LECTURER writes with 403 and allow in-scope + ADMIN; reads are scope-filtered.
/topics, /evaluations, /api/lecturer are mounted behind requireAuth (unauthenticated requests get 401); the routers/controllers are NOT deleted.
No real network calls introduced; no migration added by this feature.
verification: cd d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step5-exams\backend && npm run test:e2e (self-skips offline; must not regress baseline when Postgres present)
findings:
DONE. Verified: backend unit `npm test` = 181 pass (was 163; +18 new), backend e2e `npm run test:e2e` = 83 pass / 14 skipped / 0 fail (baseline 81 preserved, +2 new offline 401 assertions). No regressions.

New file: backend/src/auth/resolveJwtSecret.js exports { resolveJwtSecret, DEV_FALLBACK_SECRET }. resolveJwtSecret(runtimeEnv) throws Error code 'JWT_SECRET_REQUIRED' when awsMockMode===false AND secret blank; else returns secret || DEV_FALLBACK_SECRET ('aives-dev-insecure-secret'). Wired into app.js TokenService secret.

F2: app.js now mounts /topics, /evaluations, /api/lecturer behind authMiddleware.requireAuth (routers/controllers NOT deleted). Unauthenticated GET/POST to these now returns 401. IMPORTANT for later features: any e2e/offline test that calls these three mounts MUST send an auth cookie (use createTestContext.authCookie / lecturerCookie) — I updated test/crud.e2e.test.js and test/workflow.e2e.test.js to attach the LECTURER cookie on /topics and /evaluations calls (previously anonymous).

F1 scope threading (the exam-session domain should mirror this): 
- QuestionService constructor now also takes `subjectRepository`. app.js constructs ONE SubjectRepository up front and injects it into BOTH QuestionService and RubricService (and reuses it in the auth wiring). 
- QuestionService signatures changed to thread the acting user: listQuestions(filters, user), getQuestionById(id, user), createQuestion(payload, user), updateQuestion(id, payload, user), approve(id,{reviewedBy,user}), reject(id,{reason,reviewedBy,user}), archive(id,{user}), approveBatch({questionIds,rubricId,reviewedBy,user}). New private helpers: _subjectIdForTopic(topicId) via topicRepository.getById(topicId).subject_id (null => skip), _assertSubjectInScope(user, subjectId), _assertRowInScope(user, row), _filterRowsInScope(user, rows). 
- RubricService constructor now takes { repository, subjectRepository }. Signatures: listRubrics(user), getRubricById(id, user), updateRubric(id, payload, user), cloneRubric(id, user) [now does findById first for scope], deleteRubric(id, user). Uses rubric row.subject_id directly. 
- Scope rules (mirror these for exam sessions): user undefined => skip (back-compat with unit fakes); role ADMIN => bypass; subject_id null => skip (lenient fallback like _assertRubricInSubject / materialService._assertSubjectInScope); else LECTURER must be in subjectRepository.listSubjectIdsForLecturer(user.id) or throw 403 FORBIDDEN. 
- CRITICAL mock-DB caveat: the in-memory InMemoryDatabase has NO subject/subject_lecturer table, so calling listSubjectIdsForLecturer against it throws DATABASE_ERROR. Both _filterRowsInScope implementations therefore load the lecturer's subject set LAZILY — only after confirming at least one row resolves a non-null subject_id. For single-row asserts, _assertSubjectInScope returns early on null subjectId before any DB call. Exam-session scope code reused in offline e2e MUST either inject a fake subjectRepository (see test/materials.e2e.test.js FakeSubjectRepo) or keep subject_id null to stay offline-safe. 
- Controllers updated to pass req.user: questionController (all handlers) and rubricController (list/getById/update/remove/clone). req.user={id,role} is set by requireAuth.

New unit test files: test/jwtSecretGuardService.test.js, test/questionScopeService.test.js, test/rubricScopeService.test.js, test/legacyMountAuthService.test.js (supertest + createApp offline, asserts /topics /evaluations /api/lecturer/sessions => 401).
